tests.name: desktop 1440x900, signed in: /backoffice/dashboard, /backoffice/sales/leads, /backoffice/accounting/journals, /backoffice/audit/trail, /backoffice/settings/access — for a BackOffice account: ?spotlight=1 renders BackOfficeTabs directly above [data-archetype="workspace"] (full width, no horizontal scroll) and ?spotlight=0 renders today's tree without [data-archetype]; for the test user without the BackOffice role: every route still renders NotAuthorized in place (no workspace frame, no BackOffice tabs) and the BackOffice-only part is skipped with that reason

BackOffice screen flag off = legacy tree (BackOfficeTabs + BackOfficePage's padded wrapper with the screen id, no [data-archetype]); flag on = BackOfficeTabs directly above ScreenFrame "workspace" (full width, no rail, same header, capability gate and content); /backoffice/* placeholder split the same way (404 and wave body); every BackOffice page reads useSpotlightEnabled() once and never moves BackOfficeTabs inside ScreenFrame; Approvals › Policies read-only render still green
